description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and methods related to stock management in ERPNext, including stock valuation, bin management, serial number handling, and reposting checks.

classes.name: InvalidWarehouseCompany
classes.description: Custom exception for invalid warehouse and company mismatch.

classes.name: PendingRepostingError
classes.description: Custom exception for pending reposting errors.

methods.name: get_stock_value_from_bin
methods.description: Calculates total stock value for a specific warehouse and item code from stock bins.

methods.name: get_stock_value_on
methods.description: Retrieves stock value on a specific date, considering warehouse grouping.

methods.name: get_stock_balance
methods.description: Returns stock quantity or valuation rate at a warehouse for an item.

methods.name: get_serial_nos_data_after_transactions
methods.description: Fetches serial numbers after transactions up to a specific date/time.

methods.name: get_serial_nos_data
methods.description: Retrieves serial number data for given serial nos.

methods.name: get_latest_stock_qty
methods.description: Gets the latest stock quantity for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_latest_stock_balance
methods.description: Returns a map of latest stock values for all items and warehouses.

methods.name: get_bin
methods.description: Fetches or creates a stock bin for an item and warehouse.

methods.name: get_or_make_bin
methods.description: Fetches or creates a stock bin, returning its name.

methods.name: update_bin
methods.description: Updates stock bin quantities; deprecated, inline replacement recommended.

methods.name: get_incoming_rate
methods.description: Calculates incoming stock rate based on valuation method.

methods.name: get_avg_purchase_rate
methods.description: Calculates average purchase rate for serial numbers.

methods.name: get_valuation_method
methods.description: Retrieves valuation method for an item or default.

methods.name: get_fifo_rate
methods.description: Calculates FIFO rate from stock queue.

methods.name: get_valid_serial_nos
methods.description: Validates and splits serial numbers, ensuring correctness.

methods.name: validate_warehouse_company
methods.description: Checks if warehouse belongs to the specified company.

methods.name: is_group_warehouse
methods.description: Ensures warehouse is not a group node.

methods.name: validate_disabled_warehouse
methods.description: Checks if warehouse is disabled.

methods.name: update_included_uom_in_report
methods.description: Adds UOM conversion columns to report data.

methods.name: get_available_serial_nos
methods.description: Fetches serial numbers available for an item in a warehouse up to a date.

methods.name: add_additional_uom_columns
methods.description: Adds UOM conversion columns for qty/rate in report.

methods.name: get_incoming_outgoing_rate_for_cancel
methods.description: Fetches rate for stock cancellation entries.

methods.name: is_reposting_item_valuation_in_progress
methods.description: Checks if item valuation reposting is ongoing.

methods.name: check_pending_reposting
methods.description: Verifies if there are pending repost jobs up to a date.
